outOfBandPolicy.description: Reserved for a security fix, or a fix for a release that already shipped broken -- never for ordinary content that simply missed Friday's merge window (that waits for next Saturday). A changeset carrying `release: out-of-band` in its frontmatter must be `patch` level for every package it names (scripts/collect-changesets.mjs enforces this), and needs explicit owner approval before the release PR that consumes it merges.
